account: Alibaba's news site, Alizila, reported on 6 November 2024 that Baguan forecast a 20% drop in electricity demand in Shandong with 98.1% load-forecast accuracy. The article gives no date for the forecast and no measure of grid savings. The makers' paper, posted on 20 May 2025, reports a test on the last half of 2023 against the Integrated Forecasting System of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF-IFS). In that test, Baguan-Regional achieved an average improvement of 57.8% on key regional variables. The paper states that the system serves the power sector in an eastern Chinese province. The Baguan submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, reports improvements over ECMWF-IFS on selected forecast variables in regional and global comparisons. It names State Grid Shandong among the test settings. A version of the paper appeared in the proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on 3 August 2025. Better forecasting of renewable power and better grid operations are intended applications. No source quantifies a resulting change in dispatch, reliability or emissions.

ai_role.statement: The makers compare Baguan's forecasts with ECMWF-IFS forecasts and with simple interpolation of Baguan's global forecasts on the same held-out data, so the reported error reductions measure what the model adds to forecast accuracy. No source separates any effect of the forecasts on grid operations from the work of the grid company.
